mapper.select: select id, config_key, config_name, config_value, config_group, value_type, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from sys_config where config_key = #{configKey} limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_config set config_value = #{configValue}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where config_key = #{configKey}
